brief: Keeps a cluster of worker processes healthy and sized to its load: restarts dead workers, scales up under high load, drains under low.
detail: Set a Policy (a minimum and a maximum per tag), the water marks, and report the demand with ReportLoad or FeedLoadFrom. Decide is a pure function from fleet metrics to a list of actions and touches nothing; Supervise applies those actions to the live cluster and Cycle is Supervise as a tickable job for an agent host. Dead workers are restarted before any scaling; scaling stops at the policy bounds. Only Decide is safe to call on its own; Supervise and Cycle start and stop processes.
receiver:
o1 = new stzClusterSupervisor("")
o1.Policy("nlp", 1, 4)
o1.SetWaterMarks(0.25, 0.75)
o1.ReportLoad("nlp", 0.9)
